g.text: Netflix Orders YA Drama ‘Prep’ Based on Curtis Sittenfeld Novel From Nicole Taylor ◆ What Election Day Commentators Are Saying: Trump Rants, Hasan Piker Wonders if MAGA ‘Cult’ Is Over and More (Updating) ◆ Netflix Launches First AI-Branded Content Recommendations Feature on TVs ◆ Try Guys Cooking Competition ‘Without a Recipe’ Returns for Season 9 With ‘Is It Cake?’ Star JonnyCakes (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ BBC Deputy Director-General Says ‘A Lot Has Changed’ After Editing Error That Triggered Trump’s $10 Billion Lawsuit: We’re in a ‘Much Stronger Place’ ◆ Creators Pounce on Midterm Elections, Hoping to Win New Viewers and More Dollars ◆
